data.one_liner: Open-source Flutter UI kit with pre-built production-ready widgets.
data.what_it_does: GetWidget is a UI kit providing over 1,000 pre-composed widgets such as buttons, cards, carousels, forms, and avatars. It is designed to be additive and works alongside Material and Cupertino components in Flutter apps.
use_when: You want a collection of pre-styled UI components to speed up development
You need standard UI patterns like accordions, carousels, and custom buttons without building them from scratch
avoid_when: You require a completely custom design system built solely on raw Material primitives
You want to avoid adding a large third-party widget library dependency
strengths: Large collection of over 1,000 production-ready widgets
Actively maintained since 2017 with frequent Flutter compatibility updates
Additive design allows mixing with Material and Cupertino widgets
weaknesses: Can introduce a heavy dependency for projects needing only a few basic components
Might impose styling opinions that conflict with strict custom design guidelines
data.setup_notes: Add getwidget to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Google Material Design components rather than a third-party kit.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are building an iOS-centric application using Cupertino styling.
